description: This is a test source file for the JpegSizeLimiter utility, containing unit tests to verify that JPEG payloads are correctly compressed under size limits and unchanged when small.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of the JpegSizeLimiter compression functions.

methods.name: compressesLargePayloadsUnderLimit
methods.description: Test to ensure JPEG payloads being too large are compressed down to within byte limit without exceeding size constraints.

methods.name: keepsSmallPayloadsAsIs
methods.description: Test to verify small payloads are not altered in size or quality.
